lead: Build a distributor inquiry around the product families, order quantities and markets you serve. Our factory team prepares free design proposals, product mockups and model-specific quotations.
html:
Make repeat orders identifiable

Use the model, approved artwork version, color references and packing specification as the repeat-order reference. A shared name is not enough to identify an unchanged configuration.

Compare supply scope consistently

Separate product, decoration, packing and delivery requirements in your inquiry. Payment is 30% deposit, with the balance paid in full before shipment; trade terms are agreed for the order.
